props.label: Section
props.html:
Sydney blocked drain specialists

Blocked drains sorted properly, not just poked and hoped

When a drain backs up you want it flowing again quickly, and you want to know it will stay that way. We are a Sydney blocked drain and pipe relining team working across homes, businesses and strata buildings for over 20 years.

Every job starts with a proper diagnosis. We put a CCTV camera down the line so we can see exactly what is causing the blockage and where it sits, then clear it with an electric eel or high-pressure water jetter. If the pipe itself is cracked or full of roots, we can reline it from the inside with no digging, or replace it when that is the better call.

  • Residential, commercial and strata drains
  • Every blockage camera-checked before and after
  • No-dig pipe relining available across Sydney
  • Honest, upfront pricing before any work begins

props.label: Our blocked drain and pipe services
props.html:
What we do

Our blocked drain and pipe services

From a one-off blocked toilet to trenchless pipe relining, we cover the full range of drain work under one licensed team.

Electric Eel Drain Cleaning

A motorised drain machine that cuts through hair, grease and root matter in sinks, floor wastes and sewer lines.

Learn more

High Pressure Water Jetting

A hydro-jet blasts stubborn blockages apart and scours the pipe wall clean, ideal for grease and heavy build-up.

Learn more

CCTV Drain Inspection

A camera down the line shows exactly what is blocking your drain and where, so the repair is right the first time.

Learn more

Pipe Relining

Trenchless repair that rebuilds a cracked or root-damaged pipe from the inside, with no digging up the yard.

Learn more

Pipe Replacement

When a pipe is past relining we dig, replace and reinstate, from stormwater and gutter lines through to sewer.

Learn more

Blocked Toilet Repair

Fast clearing of blocked and overflowing toilets for homes, offices and strata buildings across Sydney.

Learn more

Tree Root Removal

We cut out invading roots and reline the pipe so the same blockage does not keep coming back each season.

Learn more

Commercial Drain Cleaning

Scheduled and emergency drain cleaning for cafes, restaurants, factories and strata managers around Sydney.

Learn more

Repairs & Maintenance

General drain repairs and preventative maintenance to keep your pipes flowing right through the year.

Learn more

props.label: How we fix your drain
props.html:
Our method

How we fix your drain

A clear four-step process so you know what is happening and what it will cost, before we start.

1

Diagnose with CCTV

A waterproof camera goes down the drain to find the exact cause and location of the blockage.

2

Clear the blockage

An electric eel or high-pressure jetter clears the line then and there, and we camera-check the result.

3

Repair when needed

Cracked or root-damaged pipes are relined or replaced so the fix actually lasts.

4

Prevent it returning

We show you the footage and give honest advice to help stop the same problem coming back.

props.label: Blocked drain questions, answered
props.html:
Good to know

Blocked drain questions, answered

Yes. We run a 24/7 emergency service and aim to reach most Sydney jobs within 60 minutes of your call. For urgent blockages, calling (02) 8960 0868 is the fastest way to get a plumber on the way.

Correct, there is no call-out fee to get a licensed plumber to your property. Once we have looked at the drain we give you an upfront price for the work, and you decide before anything starts.

The common culprits are tree roots getting into older clay pipes, a build-up of grease and food waste, wet wipes and sanitary items, and general debris over time. A CCTV inspection tells us which one it is so we treat the cause, not just the symptom.

If the pipe is sound, a proper clear should last. If the camera shows cracks or root intrusion, clearing alone is temporary, so we will talk you through relining or replacing that section to stop it returning.

Yes. We handle commercial and strata drains as well as homes, including scheduled maintenance for cafes, restaurants and larger properties where a blocked drain means downtime.

We cover the whole Sydney metro area, from the CBD and Inner West through to Parramatta, Blacktown, the Hills, the North Shore, the Eastern Suburbs and the south. Browse your council area above or call us to confirm.
